title: The Unnamed Drawer That Holds Itself

features.name: recursion handle
features.desc-on-touch: A brass knob that opens onto itself—when you pull, the drawer expands to contain the space it was pulled from.

features.name: nested compartments
features.desc-on-touch: Wooden dividers that hold smaller drawers that hold even smaller drawers—containment that refuses to end.

features.name: index card maze
features.desc-on-touch: Cards with names that refer to other cards, which refer back—a filing system that catalogues only its own confusion.

features.name: drawer bottom
features.desc-on-touch: You reach it and find it is not a bottom—just deeper wood, more darkness, another compartment beginning.

features.name: dust-mote constellation
features.desc-on-touch: The air inside the drawer holds patterns—each mote traces a path the drawer has taken through itself.

inscription: each drawer contained less and held more than the drawer before it; inside is where the drawer learned to become infinite

file.name: Compartment_Taxonomy_Unfinished_Self_Reference.txt
file.note: An attempt to catalogue every drawer, each entry revealing that this compartment is being described by something inside it.
